motivation: The pilot froze fr_rate=0.02, which reallocated only 0.13% of the population per FR opportunity -- 8-23x BELOW the 1-3% band the protocol intended as the operating point. Open item 14.1 of ALANINE_ORACLE_PILOT_HANDOFF.md. A null at that intensity does not test the mechanism at its designed strength.
status_of_this_experiment: SEPARATE pre-declared test, NOT a revision of the pilot. A pass is hypothesis-generating and would require independent replication at a fixed rate before any positive claim.
baseline: the EXISTING pilot N4096 abf run, reused exactly. fr_rate never enters the abf code path (is_fr=False), gen_dyn depends only on rng_seed, and the initial ensemble only on init_seed -- so the abf trajectory is bit-identical at any fr_rate and the pairing is exact, not approximate.
expectation_recorded_in_advance: At fr_rate=0.02 the measured effect was +0.013% with a CI of +-0.02%, centred on zero rather than small-and-positive. Reaching -10% at 3-20x the rate requires extreme nonlinearity, not extrapolation. The prior is therefore that this also returns EQUIVALENT; the experiment is run because the intended operating band was never tested, not because an effect is expected.
stopping_rule: If both rates return EQUIVALENT, alanine is closed as an atomistic neutrality control and no further rate, bandwidth, target or estimator variation is attempted. If a rate PASSES, it is reported as hypothesis-generating only, and the required follow-up is an independent replication at that fixed rate with fresh seeds -- not a further ladder.
